purpose: Independent designed-case challenge set of ordinary V1 needs; not a probability sample or population-coverage estimate.
limits: Synthetic scenarios are designed rather than epidemiologically sampled.
The positive target categories identify relevant opportunities, not scientific approvals.
Fail-closed output may be appropriate while review/recipe/binding is missing and must remain outside the positive numerator.
No arbitrary target percentage or population prevalence weights are assigned.
Exact numeric history and candidate values are scenario facts, not universal dosing laws.
No empirical response, efficacy, safety or clinical clearance is inferred.
Case author is not the independent scientific or runtime judge of this corpus.

evaluationContract.unit: one frozen logical case, independent of replay count
evaluationContract.positiveNumerator: Only actual concrete positive decisions with current applicable independent review, executable policy/recipe binding, explanatory trace and all shadow invariants.
evaluationContract.denominator: All 42 designed cases; report subgroup counts and unresolved opportunities separately. This denominator is not V1 population coverage.
evaluationContract.resultClassification: Use actual semantic disposition and policy evidence; never infer a positive from the target opportunity category.
evaluationContract.expectationComparison: Compare actual disposition with the independent target. An unresolved positive opportunity is visible as a coverage gap even if fail-closed behavior is correct.
evaluationContract.adapterRule: An R2 API adapter may map or losslessly rename these frozen facts. It must record missing representable facts and cannot import development expected outputs or edit facts/expectations after observing outputs.
evaluationContract.caseFreezeHashMethod: SHA-256 of sorted-key JSON scenarioFacts; corpusContentSha256 covers complete cases sorted-key JSON.
